description: §9.5 (AP-RESOLVE-001): each case gives the chain, oldest first (each profile's exact-id, its schema for this kind of record and its lens from the profile before), the writer and the reader, the record, the requested columns where there are any, and the expected record or problem (resolution_failed, with the target where §9.5 gives one). Numbers compare as binary64 values. A Columnar client's column-wise resolution of every row case, as a table of one row and of many, gives the same records (AP-RESOLVE-002). `dynamic_schema` marks a capability with the trait DynamicSchema.
